claims.statement: Tom Allen wrote to a St. Louis friend that he would buy Gallagher's business at a fair valuation and buy out other champions who wished to sell.

notes: Letter to a friend, reported second-hand by the paper; the last lines are garbled. The hint that challengers should leave terms at Allen's saloon is not in the text and was dropped.
